typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	ExportDate as string (),
	ExportFile_335 as string (),
	ExportFile_342 as string (),
	ExportFile_343 as string (),
	ExportFolder as string (),
	Market as string (),
	MarketName as string (),
	MarketNames as string (),
	ScrubFile_Full_335 as string (),
	ScrubFile_Full_342 as string (),
	ScrubFile_Full_343 as string (),
	vPDS_Connection as string ()
}

source(output(
		MEMBER_NAME as string,
		AGENT_ID as string,
		CASE_ID as string,
		DOB as timestamp,
		CALL_DATE as timestamp,
		DISPOSITIONCODE_DESCRIPTION as string,
		USER_TYPE as string,
		SCRUB_RULE_CD as string,
		MEMBER_ID as string,
		SCRUB_RULE_DESCRIPTION as string,
		SCRUB_DATE as timestamp,
		DISPOSITIONCODE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'select DISTINCT M.MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER as MEMBER_ID 				,RTrim(Ltrim(M.MEMBER_FIRST_NAME)) + \' \' + RTrim(Ltrim(M.MEMBER_LAST_NAME)) as MEMBER_NAME 				,M.MEMBER_BIRTH_DT as DOB 				,CD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE as SCRUB_DATE 				,CR.CALLLISTRULE_CD as SCRUB_RULE_CD 				,CR.CALLLISTRULE_DESC as SCRUB_RULE_DESCRIPTION 				,CS.CALLLISTSTATUS_LASTDISPOSITION_DT as CALL_DATE 				,DC.DISPOSITIONCODE_CD as DISPOSITIONCODE 				,DC.DISPOSITIONCODE_DESCRIPTION as DISPOSITIONCODE_DESCRIPTION	 				,CS.CALLLISTSTATUS_AGENT as AGENT_ID				 				,HIST.CALLLIST_335_HISTORY_CASE_ID AS CASE_ID 				,\'Cancer – Dietitian\'  AS USER_TYPE FROM PDS_CALLLIST CL INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTDATE CD ON CL.CALLLIST_IID = CD.CALLLISTDATE_CALLLIST_IID            INNER JOIN  (select Max(CALLLISTDATE_IID) as MAX_CALLLISTDATE_IID  ,CALLLISTDATE_CALLLIST_IID from PDS_CALLLISTDATE Group by CALLLISTDATE_CALLLIST_IID) CD1  ON  CD.CALLLISTDATE_IID =CD1.MAX_CALLLISTDATE_IID	 AND CD1.CALLLISTDATE_CALLLIST_IID =  CL.CALLLIST_IID  INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTMASTER CM ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_CALLLISTDATE_IID = CD.CALLLISTDATE_IID AND CM.CALLLISTMASTER_ACTIVE_IND = 0 INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTRULE CR ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_INACTIVE_CALLLISTRULE_IID = CR.CALLLISTRULE_IID INNER JOIN PDS_MEMBER M ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_ENTITY_IID = M.MEMBER_IID	   LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_CALLLIST_335_HISTORY_TASKS CCNT  ON CCNT.CALLLIST_335_HISTORY_TASK_IID = CM.CALLLISTMASTER_EXTRADATA_IID AND CL.CALLLIST_CD =\'343\' LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_CALLLIST_335_HISTORY HIST  ON HIST.CALLLIST_335_HISTORY_CASE_IID = COALESCE(CCNT.CALLLIST_335_HISTORY_TASK_CASE_IID,CM.CALLLISTMASTER_EXTRADATA_IID) AND CL.CALLLIST_CD =\'343\' INNER JOIN [dbo].[PDS_RPT_UNITJOB] RU ON RU.UNITJOB_IID = CM.CALLLISTMASTER_UNITJOB_IID LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTSTATUS CS ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_ENTITY_IID = CS.CALLLISTSTATUS_ENTITY_IID AND CL.CALLLIST_IID = CS.CALLLISTSTATUS_CALLLIST_IID LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_DISPOSITIONCODE DC ON CS.CALLLISTSTATUS_LASTDISPOSITIONCODE_IID = DC.DISPOSITIONCODE_IID WHERE CL.CALLLIST_CD = \'343\' AND  RU.UNITJOB_NAME=?',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		MEMBER_NAME as string,
		AGENT_ID as string,
		CASE_ID as string,
		DOB as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CALL_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		DISPOSITIONCODE_DESCRIPTION as string,
		USER_TYPE as string,
		SCRUB_RULE_CD as string,
		MEMBER_ID as string,
		SCRUB_RULE_DESCRIPTION as string,
		SCRUB_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		DISPOSITIONCODE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		MEMBER_NAME,
		AGENT_ID,
		CASE_ID,
		DOB,
		CALL_DATE,
		DISPOSITIONCODE_DESCRIPTION,
		USER_TYPE,
		SCRUB_RULE_CD,
		MEMBER_ID,
		SCRUB_RULE_DESCRIPTION,
		SCRUB_DATE,
		DISPOSITIONCODE)) ~> FlatFileDestination
